newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Kumpulan Fima eyes bank stake.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Kumpulan Fima eyes bank stake.

text.p: Newly-listed Kumpulan Fima Bhd has obtained approval from Malaysia's central bank, Bank Negara, to start negotiations to acquire a stake in Bank of Nova Scotia Bhd.
In a statement released late on Monday, the company said it would negotiate the purchase of the locally-incorporated bank with Canada's Bank of Nova Scotia.
Kumpulan Fima said it proposed to own a 51 percent stake in the bank while Bank of Nova Scotia will retain the remaining 49 percent.

Kumpulan Fima, which was listed on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange's main board on November 15, is involved in a wide range of activity that covered bulking and storage services, property development, manufacturing and stockbroking.
The stock closed at 3.38 ringgit on Monday.
